create_dataset_from_config: create a dataset from a config dictionary using create_dataset with a specified split name
filter_dataset_by_max_atoms: create a dataset subset filtered by max_atoms using the create_dataset config option
shuffle_and_sample_dataset: create a shuffled dataset subset with sample_n samples using the create_dataset function
access_dataset_metadata: get metadata attributes for dataset samples using the get_metadata method on a BaseDataset instance
create_subset_with_metadata: create a Subset wrapper around a BaseDataset that preserves metadata access for a list of indices
